cfnResources.name: CfnSecret
cfnResources.notes: Secret L2. CFN embeds the value + generateSecretString on the single AWS::SecretsManager::Secret. Terraform splits: aws_secretsmanager_secret (metadata: name/description/kms_key_id/replica) + a SEPARATE aws_secretsmanager_secret_version (secret_string). generateSecretString is a server-side generator in CFN with NO metadata equivalent on the TF secret resource -> compose with random-password generation (random_password resource or data-aws-secretsmanager-random-password) feeding secret_version. Empty generateSecretString ({}) is the CFN 'auto-generate 32 chars' sentinel.

cfnResources.name: CfnSecretTargetAttachment
cfnResources.notes: NO terraform provider resource (explicitly named in conventions.md as CFN-side merge magic). SecretTargetAttachment.attach() merges connection fields (host/port/dbname/engine) from the target INTO the secret value server-side. Port via sanctioned API superset (SecretAttachmentTargetProps gains optional connectionFields) + prepare-time composition merging into aws_secretsmanager_secret_version with jsonencode(merge(jsondecode(base), fields)). Reject invalid combinations (merging into a scalar secret value) at construct time with ValidationError.

cfnResources.name: CfnRotationSchedule
cfnResources.notes: RotationSchedule + HostedRotation.bind. TF aws_secretsmanager_secret_rotation takes secret_id + rotation_lambda_arn + rotation_rules{ schedule_expression | automatically_after_days }. ZERO-DURATION (Duration.days(0)) -> CFN omits RotationRules; TF requires a populated rotation_rules block, empty block fails tofu validate -> throw ValidationError at construct time (conventions correctness rule). hostedRotationLambda (CFN transform AWS::SecretsManager-2024-09-16) has NO TF equivalent -> HostedRotation likely unsupported; throw/skip.

cfnResources.name: CfnResourcePolicy
cfnResources.notes: ResourcePolicy. TF aws_secretsmanager_secret_policy { secret_arn, policy (jsonencode of iam.PolicyDocument), block_public_policy }. Follow iam/policy.ts toTerraform() composition idiom for the resource-policy render.

srcFiles.notes: ANCHOR file (exports ISecret/Secret consumed by all siblings). Extend AwsConstructBase (SecretBase -> abstract base extending AwsConstructBase, implements ISecret + iam capability marker interfaces). PROPERTY_INJECTION_ID + get outputs() ({ secretArn, secretName }, Topic-style). CRITICAL RISK: SecretValue is NOT ported in this repo (only TODO stubs in compute/vpn.ts, storage/parameter.ts). Upstream secret.ts depends on core SecretValue for secretStringValue/secretObjectValue/secretValue/secretValueFromJson/cfnDynamicReferenceKey. Converter MUST check src core for a SecretValue equivalent first; if absent, represent concrete initial values via aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.secret_string and drop/skip the CFN-dynamic-reference-only APIs (cfnDynamicReferenceKey, secretValue/secretValueFromJson returning SecretValue). SecretStringValueBeta1 (deprecated) + fromSecretArn (deprecated) -> drop their tests. NAMING (invariant 1): exact-name form -> name: props.secretName ?? this.stack.uniqueResourceName(this) (mirror topic.ts/kinesis-stream.ts; secrets are ARN/name-referenced and name_prefix churn changes the ARN + hits the 7-30 day deletion blackout). Expose public readonly resource: secretsmanagerSecret.SecretsmanagerSecret. fromSecretName/fromSecretNameV2/fromSecretCompleteArn/fromSecretPartialArn/fromSecretAttributes import variants: preserve ARN-form-aware parsing (partial vs complete suffix) + edge tests. replicaRegions -> aws_secretsmanager_secret.replica[] (Lazy.listValue for imperative addReplicaRegion). CfnSecretTargetAttachment path = composition (see cfnResources). Circular import with policy.ts + rotation-schedule.ts is expected (method-body use only, safe). WIRES THE BARREL: add 'export * from "./secret"', './rotation-schedule', './policy', './secret-rotation' to encryption/index.ts (full compile only green once all four files land).

Small: ResourcePolicy wrapping aws_secretsmanager_secret_policy. Extend AwsConstructBase, PROPERTY_INJECTION_ID. public readonly document = new iam.PolicyDocument() (NO assignSids unless sibling uses it). secret_arn from props.secret.secretArn. Render policy via iam/policy.ts toTerraform() composition idiom. Imports ISecret from secret.ts (order 1). Does NOT import rotation-schedule.ts -> same order 2 is safe.

RotationSchedule + HostedRotation + HostedRotationType. TF aws_secretsmanager_secret_rotation. Schedule.rate from '../notify' (Schedule is in notify, not a separate events module). kms.ViaServicePrincipal -> encryption ViaServicePrincipal (already ported). encryptionKey.grantEncryptDecrypt already on encryption IKey (note: upstream uses newer keyRef/IKeyRef which is NOT in this repo's key.ts -> use encryptionKey.keyArn directly). ZERO-DURATION -> ValidationError (see cfnResources). 4h/1000d bounds preserved. HostedRotation (CFN transform, hostedRotationLambda) has NO TF equivalent -> throw UnscopedValidationError/skip its tests with a 'Not supported by Terraform Provider' reason. Imports ISecret+Secret from secret.ts (order 1); does NOT import policy.ts -> same order 2 safe. denyAccountRootDelete on the secret preserved.

SecretRotationApplication (static SAR app catalog) + SecretRotation construct. HARD BLOCKER: upstream deploys an AWS-published Serverless Application Repository app via aws-sam serverless.CfnApplication (AWS::Serverless::Application) — serverlessrepo has NO terraform-provider-aws resource and never will. Also depends on aws-ec2 (compute: IVpc/SubnetSelection/IConnectable/SecurityGroup) + aws-lambda (compute: Function.fromFunctionArn). SecretRotationApplication (the pure ARN/version catalog class + applicationArnForPartition/semanticVersionForPartition) IS portable as-is. SecretRotation construct is NOT directly representable (SAR deploy). Converter options: (a) port SecretRotationApplication only + stub SecretRotation to throw a ValidationError with a '// TODO: AWS::Serverless::Application (SAR) has no Terraform equivalent' breadcrumb, or (b) skip the construct body and its tests with a documented reason. Do NOT synthesize an invalid/half resource. Lowest priority; convert AFTER the other three. Imports ISecret from secret.ts only.

testFilesNotes: example.app-with-secret.lit.ts and integ.secret.lit.ts in upstream test/ are doc/integ .lit snippets, not jest suites -> not mapped as unit tests. Use test/aws/notify/queue.test.ts + test/aws/notify/sns.test.ts as harness exemplars (AwsStack construction, environmentName/gridUUID, Template.synth from test/assertions.ts which forces prepareStack). Drop tests for un-ported APIs (SecretValue-returning secretValue/secretValueFromJson, cfnDynamicReferenceKey, deprecated fromSecretArn/SecretStringValueBeta1, HostedRotation, SecretRotation/SAR); comment-skip provider-unsupported cases with a reason line.

integChoice.reason: Cheapest integ that exercises the core Secret resource: a single default Secret + one addReplicaRegion('eu-central-1'). No SecretValue (unported), no IAM roles/users, no VPC, no Lambda, no rotation, no deprecated patterns. Rejected alternatives: integ.secret.lit.ts and integ.secret.dynamic-reference-key.ts both depend on core SecretValue + cfnDynamicReferenceKey (unported/CFN-only); integ.lambda-rotation.ts and integ.hosted-rotation.ts pull in VPC + Lambda + SAR/hosted rotation (heaviest, and SAR/hosted have no TF equivalent); integ.secret-name-parsed.ts ships a Lambda handler. secret.replica cleanly validates aws_secretsmanager_secret + replica block. Go validator asserts the replica region literal 'eu-central-1' and the generated secret name scoping. Sibling app exemplars: integ/aws/encryption/apps/key.ts, key-alias.ts.

layoutNotes: DIR + EXPORT STRATEGY: aws-secretsmanager -> encryption namespace (per conventions registry + PR #117). All four hand-ported files land FLAT in src/aws/encryption/ alongside key.ts/alias.ts/via-service-principal.ts and are FLAT-re-exported from src/aws/encryption/index.ts (append 'export * from "./secret" | "./rotation-schedule" | "./policy" | "./secret-rotation"'). NO subdirectory/namespaced re-export is needed here: the compute/notify 'export * as <ns>' pattern is the precedent for COLLISIONS, and there are none. COLLISION CHECK (verified): existing encryption exports are Key/KeyBase/IKey/KeySpec/KeyUsage/KeyProps/KeyOutputs, Alias/AliasBase/IAlias/AliasProps/AliasAttributes/AliasOutputs, ViaServicePrincipal, KeyLookup. Incoming exports (Secret/SecretBase(not exported)/ISecret/SecretProps/ReplicaRegion/SecretAttributes/SecretStringValueBeta1/ISecretAttachmentTarget/AttachmentTargetType/SecretAttachmentTargetProps/AttachedSecretOptions/SecretTargetAttachmentProps/ISecretTargetAttachment/SecretTargetAttachment/SecretStringGenerator, ResourcePolicy/ResourcePolicyProps, RotationSchedule/RotationScheduleOptions/RotationScheduleProps/SingleUserHostedRotationOptions/MultiUserHostedRotationOptions/HostedRotation/HostedRotationType, SecretRotation/SecretRotationApplication/SecretRotationApplicationOptions/SecretRotationProps) — ZERO filename collisions (no existing secret.ts/policy.ts/rotation-schedule.ts/secret-rotation.ts) and ZERO exported-symbol collisions with the kms exports. jsii-safe. ALREADY-PORTED CODE TO REUSE (import, do not duplicate): encryption IKey/Key + grantEncrypt/grantDecrypt/grantEncryptDecrypt/grant (../, same namespace), encryption ViaServicePrincipal (replaces kms.ViaServicePrincipal), iam (Grant/PolicyDocument/PolicyStatement/Effect/ServicePrincipal/AccountRootPrincipal/AccountPrincipal/addToPrincipalOrResource/AddToResourcePolicyResult from '../iam'), notify Schedule (Schedule.rate, replaces aws-events), AwsConstructBase/AwsConstructProps ('../aws-construct.ts'), AwsStack.ofAwsConstruct + stack.uniqueResourceName/uniqueResourceNamePrefix, ValidationError/UnscopedValidationError ('../../errors'). NOT AVAILABLE (design risks, flagged per-file): (1) core SecretValue — not ported (only TODO stubs) — blocks secretStringValue/secretObjectValue/secretValue/secretValueFromJson/cfnDynamicReferenceKey; concrete values go through aws_secretsmanager_secret_version, dynamic-reference APIs get dropped/skipped. (2) kms IKeyRef/keyRef — not in repo key.ts — use encryptionKey.keyArn. (3) aws-sam serverlessrepo CfnApplication — no TF equivalent — SecretRotation construct blocked (port SecretRotationApplication catalog only, stub/throw the construct). (4) CfnSecretTargetAttachment + hostedRotationLambda — no TF resource — composition/throw. ORDER + CIRCULARITY: the module is inherently circular (secret<->policy, secret<->rotation-schedule via method-body use). Resolved by anchoring secret.ts at order 1 (exports ISecret/Secret; its forward refs to ResourcePolicy/RotationSchedule are runtime-only, safe), then policy.ts + rotation-schedule.ts at order 2 (both import from secret.ts, NEITHER imports the other -> same-order rule honored), then secret-rotation.ts at order 3 (imports secret.ts only). BARREL WIRING assigned to the secret.ts converter (order 1), which appends all four export lines; full tsc green only after all four files exist (guaranteed by plan).
